message.content:
Your current outfit has a strong silhouette with the blouse and wide-leg trousers, and the khaki top creates a nice neutral base near your face. The burgundy pants add a bold splash of color that contrasts well but feels quite loud on its own.

Verdict: wear_with_change

Works:
- About palette: Items p1 (khaki blouse), p1-2 (burgundy trousers). The khaki is in your edge palette and sits nicely near your face, providing a calm anchor for the brighter burgundy below it.
- About contrast: Item p1. The soft lightness of the khaki creates a gentle transition to the skin without being too stark, keeping the look balanced.

Change:
- Id c1: Items p1-2. Replacing the wide-leg burgundy trousers with a beige skirt will mute the loud chroma and soften the lower half. This change brings both pieces into one register of saturation, so they harmonize better while still letting the blouse remain the quiet focus.
